author: Mepanda2
body:
Teams to me is about Teamwork and Loyalty, and if you think I am not 'Loyal' because I disbanded my clan... well thats not true. I ONLY disbanded it due to some reasons which I had thought I was not in the state to run a clan. We were Successful but not because of me but my players who had well played with the determination to WIN. I now think it is time for me to move on  to the actual reason I made this post, which was to join a new clan, and to start Fresh.

Application:

IGN: 3picRises (You should know this xD)
Position: Rusher
K/D: I don't think K/D Matters, anyways my K/D has dropped because I have been messing around.
K/D:1.2705
PVP K/D:1.4464
Skype: spaceman.champ
Time on Per Day: 2 Hours or More

Pros And Cons:

Pros: I am really good with my bows:Long ranged and Short Ranged, also Combos :D. I am quick at making armour and destroying monuments. Lastly I  am mostly mature at most times ;3.

Cons: My weaknesses are Sometimes being bad with a sword, when it comes to block-hitting. At times I do have moments where I get angry, but thats only if anyone insults me or my friends.

PS: I think I have more to add but I forgot I will add 'em to the list xD.

Thanks I hope some people will consider me...
